initialFindings: The new throttle fixture initially drained an intentionally unsent search; it now yields until readiness.
The initial full run retained the old generic-timeout assertion. It was updated only to the intentional auctionNotReady status; no-query/no-purchase/no-idle-loop assertions remain.

behavior: Explicit native Upgrade/Keep current before tier, replacement, inherited policy or old-item junk changes; separate buy press.
Revalidate live target/reference/eligibility/level/price mode on acceptance; dismiss/combat/close/stale callbacks preserve state.
Parse health/mana axes independently using effect text; no new named potion tiers or item/spell ID catalogue.
One modern name-free potion-category fallback after completed empty phrase queries; no old-AH bulk restock scan.
Unsent native query has no result generation; ready event wakes the existing bounded wait; unavailable queue is not empty market.
Load the dynamically linked restore spell once per job; reconsider a negative parse once when slow spell text becomes ready.
Loaded metadata is not re-requested by the pending classifier; duplicate item replies previously cleared retry evidence indefinitely.
Known level/skill/class rejection precedes restore parsing; caps/vendor filters/cache budgets/native purchase ownership remain.
